title: We Earn EcoVadis Silver Medal, Ranked Among Top 15% of Companies Worldwide
summary: We're proud to announce that we have earned a Silver Medal in the 2026 EcoVadis sustainability assessment.
body_markdown:
**By Dora Mokos, Senior Sustainability Specialist**


[Sustainability](https://novanta.com/about/sustainability/) is not a standalone initiative. It is an ongoing commitment that influences how we operate, engage with suppliers, support employees, and create long-term value for stakeholders.


We’re proud to announce that we have earned a Silver Medal in the[2026 EcoVadis sustainability assessment,](https://recognition.ecovadis.com/Pk8IfK4hPE24AAZMYl7vKQ) placing us among the top 15% of companies evaluated worldwide.


This recognition reflects meaningful progress across our global organization and reinforces our commitment to responsible business practices.


## **A Comprehensive View of Sustainability Performance**


EcoVadis is one of the world’s leading providers of business sustainability ratings, evaluating organizations across four key areas:


- Environment


- Labor & Human Rights


- Ethics


- Sustainable Procurement


We have improved our performance in all four categories compared to our previous assessment and demonstrated continued advancement across a broad range of sustainability initiatives.


## **The Work Behind the Recognition**


Achieving this result required collaboration across teams, sites, and functions throughout the company.


Key contributors to our performance include:


- Maintaining internationally recognized certifications, including ISO 14001 for environmental management, ISO 45001 for occupational health and safety, and ISO 27001 for information security.


- Providing externally assured metrics and transparent sustainability reporting.


- Strengthening supplier engagement and due diligence programs focused on sustainability, responsible sourcing, and conflict minerals compliance.


Together, these efforts help ensure that sustainability considerations remain embedded in our operations and decision-making processes.


## **Why It Matters**


Independent assessments such as EcoVadis provide objective, evidence-based validation of sustainability management practices. Rather than relying on self-reported claims, the evaluation is based on documented policies, actions, and measurable results.


As sustainability expectations continue to grow across industries, many organizations use EcoVadis ratings when evaluating suppliers and business partners. The assessment helps provide transparency and demonstrates a company’s commitment to responsible and sustainable business practices.


Customers and partners can also access our detailed EcoVadis scorecard directly through the EcoVadis platform.


## **Continuing to Raise the Bar**


While earning a Silver Medal is an important milestone, we view it as part of a continuous journey.


We remain focused on advancing environmental sustainability initiatives, fostering an inclusive and engaged workforce, maintaining strong governance practices, and driving responsible business performance across our global operations.


As we continue to improve, our goal remains clear:[creating innovative solutions](https://novanta.com/about/vision-mission/) while helping build a more sustainable future for generations to come.
